meta.title: NOURRA.AI | AI data centres, fit-out and operations in Southeast Asia
meta.description: NOURRA, based in Singapore, builds AI data centres in Southeast Asia, with its own fit-out and operations teams, and supplies verified GPU compute and enterprise cloud alongside.

h1: fit it out and run it.
hero.lede: NOURRA works from Singapore on AI compute infrastructure in Southeast Asia. We build our own AI data centres and use our own engineering and operations teams to rack GPU clusters and keep them running. GPU supply and cloud are verified by us and delivered alongside.
hero.note: We share site location, power capacity and power-on dates in writing when we talk. External GPU supply we haven’t re-checked in two weeks doesn’t get quoted.

diagram.aria: Diagram: our own data centre, fit-out crews and operations team, plus verified GPU and cloud supply, delivered by NOURRA as a running cluster.

problems.title: Four places a compute deal usually gets stuck

items.q: GPUs without a rack, racks without power
items.d: Servers, rack space, power and network sit with different parties. One missing piece keeps the cluster dark.
items.a: Rack space and power are in our own data centre, and racking and operations are our own teams. One party owns the schedule.

items.q: Work subcontracted until nobody is accountable
items.d: The main contractor passes it down, the subcontractor hires day labour, and no one can vouch for quality or dates.
items.a: Our own engineering team does the works and the racking. The plan names who is responsible for each item.

items.d: Everything works on handover day. After that, inspections, faults and expansion are each someone else’s problem.
items.a: The same team stays on for operations, with response times and inspections set in an SLA.

items.q: Plenty of GPU quotes, no way to tell which are real
items.d: The same batch gets relayed through several people. Stock on hand, future allocations and units already sold all look alike.
items.a: We grade external supply by how well it’s verified, quote only what we’ve checked recently, and confirm end user and use in writing first.

services.title: Four things we do, alone or joined into one deal

items.name: Our AI data centres and colocation
items.fit: AI companies and compute operators that need high-density rack space, and partners or investors in AI data centre projects in Southeast Asia.
do: Build high-density data centres for GPU clusters around Singapore
Provide rack space, power and cooling, including colocation for your own hardware
When our own capacity is booked, source partner sites whose power and permits we have checked
items.get: Written rack and power details, with power-on dates and billing start.

items.name: Data centre fit-out subcontracting
items.fit: Data centre owners, main contractors and hardware owners that need a dependable local crew.
do: Server racking, cabling and data centre relocation
Join a main contractor’s project as subcontractor and deliver to drawings and milestones
For high-density liquid cooling and GPU cluster networking we assign specialist engineers per project and name who is responsible
items.get: An itemised scope, schedule and acceptance criteria.

items.name: On-site operations
items.fit: Data centre owners and compute customers whose hardware is racked and needs long-term care.
do: On-site staffing, routine inspections and fault handling
items.get: An operations SLA stating response times, inspection scope and reporting.

items.name: GPU compute and enterprise cloud
items.fit: Teams that need whole servers or clusters, and companies with significant monthly cloud spend, deployed outside mainland China.
do: Match lease or purchase supply to your model, quantity and term, and verify whether it is on hand or a future allocation
Hardware goes straight into our data centre for racking, with no hand-offs in between
Enterprise accounts, discounts and model APIs on major public clouds through authorised resellers
Cloud and model services are for a company’s own normal usage, only where their providers support them
items.get: A written quote stating supply status, commercial terms, delivery date and validity.

modes.title: Two ways to work with us, agreed before you sign
modes.intro: The difference is how much you hand to us. Before each deal starts we state the scope, who is responsible and how the fee is made up, in writing.

items.name: Full delivery
items.lead: You sign one contract with NOURRA. Rack space, fit-out, racking and operations are all ours.
items.duty: Deliver and operate the scope and dates set in the contract
items.fit: You are taking a cluster from nothing to live and want one accountable party
items.fee: Contract price and payment milestones are set in the contract

items.name: Single scope
items.lead: Hand us one piece: colocation, fit-out subcontracting, operations, or an introduction to GPU supply.
items.contract: A single-scope contract with NOURRA. For supply introductions you contract with the supplier directly
items.duty: Complete the agreed scope. For introductions, verify supply and coordinate terms
items.fit: You already have a site or a main contractor and are missing one link
items.fee: Quoted per scope. Any introduction fee is stated in writing beforehand

process.title: From first conversation to a running cluster

steps.d: Model or compute size, quantity, location, target go-live date, lease or buy.
Written confirmation of who will use it, where, and for what. If this step fails, we stop here.
We settle rack space, power, works scope and operations. External supply is verified item by item before it goes into the plan.
A written quote with validity, delivery conditions, and whether it is full delivery or a single scope.
Arrival, racking, commissioning and power-on, accepted against contract milestones.
Operations under the SLA. Before the term ends we agree renewal, expansion or exit.

trust.title: Our own teams, and the rules we apply to every deal
trust.intro: We don’t yet have client work we can name publicly. This is how we work, and you can check each point as we go.

ladder.title: External supply gets one of four grades. Only the top two are quoted
ladder.note: Any resource not re-checked within two weeks drops out of our quotes.

rules.d: Site, fit-out and operations are done by our own people. The plan names who is responsible for each item.
For GPU requests we confirm end user, location and use in writing before discussing supply.
Scope, delivery dates and what happens on non-delivery go into the quote and the contract.

wont: Supply or tranship to countries, regions or end users restricted by export controls
Act as a nominee buyer or contracting party on someone else’s behalf
Support model distillation, resale of personal subscriptions, or gambling businesses

team.text: [To add: publishable background of the founding team and partners]

items.q: Are the data centres NOURRA’s own?
items.a: We are building our own AI data centres and also source rack space at partner sites. We share location, power capacity and power-on dates in writing when we talk.

items.q: Do you do the fit-out and operations yourselves, or pass them on?
items.a: Our own engineering and operations teams do the work. For specialist items such as high-density liquid cooling and GPU cluster networking we assign specialist engineers per project and name who is responsible.
GPU hardware comes from suppliers we have verified, or you bring your own. We verify supply, coordinate terms, and rack and operate the hardware in our data centre.
It depends on when the rack space powers on and whether supply is on hand or a future allocation. The quote gives a date for each stage. We don’t make blanket promises.

items.q: Why are there no prices on this site?
items.a: Rack space, works and GPU prices all move with scale, term and the market. We quote in writing against your conditions, with a validity date.

items.q: Can equipment be shipped to mainland China or other controlled destinations?
items.a: No. We only serve requirements used lawfully in permitted locations, and we confirm end user and location in writing.
